steps.label: Chop red bell pepper
steps.recipe_text: Chop-Chop 1/4 red bell pepper into tiny bits

steps.label: Add cheese to cup
steps.recipe_text: Add-Add 1/3 cup cheddar cheese to a microwave-safe cup

steps.label: Place pepper in bowl
steps.recipe_text: Place-Place the chopped pepper in the microwave-safe bowl

steps.label: Add water to bowl
steps.recipe_text: Add-Add 1 tablespoons of water to the bowl

steps.label: Microwave cup to melt
steps.recipe_text: Melt-Melt the cheese by microwaving cup for 30 sec. (Check after 30 seconds and microwave for 10 seconds more if needed)

steps.label: Microwave bowl covered
steps.recipe_text: Microwave-Microwave the bowl, covered, for 2 minutes

steps.label: Mix cheese and pepper
steps.recipe_text: Mix-Mix the cheese and red bell pepper in the bowl

steps.label: Add pepper to bowl
steps.recipe_text: Add-Add 1/4 teaspoon pepper to the bowl

steps.label: Add salt to bowl
steps.recipe_text: Add-Add 1/4 teaspoon salt to the bowl

steps.label: Add butter to bowl
steps.recipe_text: add-add 1/2 tbsp softened butter to the bowl

steps.label: Mix bowl ingredients well
steps.recipe_text: Mix-Mix all the ingredients of the bowl well
